payload.reason: The evidence indicates that Twitter data provides a better representation of language use in certain regions and has fewer missing languages compared to other data sources, which supports the hypothesis that it makes better predictions about language inventory.

claims.text: Twitter data provides a better representation of language use in North America and Oceania compared to other data sources.
Twitter has fewer missing languages compared to other corpora, which contributes to its better predictive capability regarding language inventory.
The correlation of Twitter data with actual populations is higher than that of web-crawled data, indicating its superior predictive power.
